XMLDB.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS Live engagement (Mentimeter clone) — Phase E.0 schema plus the H4 SSE-concurrency-cap table added 2026-09-04. 6 tables: sessions, slides, responses, participants, events, sse. Tables prefixed local_sentientia_live_ for global uniqueness.

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_live_sessions
TABLE.COMMENT:
A live engagement session — one row per Mentimeter-style event a trainer creates. Lifecycle: draft (created but not started) → live (audience can join + respond) → ended (final state; results frozen).
The 6-digit code is the audience join key. Generated randomly at insert; collision-checked. Trainer URL accesses by id; audience URL accesses by code.
Multi-tenant scope: customerid + tenantid derived from the creating user's open_path at session creation time — pinned to the row so a later open_path change doesn't move the session across tenants mid-run.

FIELD.NAME: code
FIELD.COMMENT: 6-digit numeric join code. Globally unique while session is in live state — recyclable after ended.

FIELD.NAME: ownerid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to user.id — trainer who created and runs the session

FIELD.NAME: customerid
FIELD.COMMENT: Sentientia LMS customer scope. Phase 1: hardcoded 1 (Airpay).

FIELD.NAME: tenantid
FIELD.COMMENT: BizLMS tenant root. Pinned at session creation.

FIELD.NAME: title
FIELD.COMMENT: Trainer-facing name for the session

FIELD.NAME: state
FIELD.COMMENT: 'draft' / 'live' / 'ended'

FIELD.NAME: current_slide_id
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_sentientia_live_slides.id — which slide is currently shown to the audience. NULL = session not yet started.

FIELD.NAME: settings_json
FIELD.COMMENT: JSON: {allow_anonymous: bool, show_results_to_audience: bool, allow_late_join: bool, max_concurrent: int, ...}

FIELD.NAME: timestarted
FIELD.COMMENT: When the session transitioned to live state

FIELD.NAME: timeended
FIELD.COMMENT: When the session transitioned to ended state

INDEX.NAME: idx_code_state
INDEX.COMMENT: Audience join: find live session by code

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_live_slides

FIELD.NAME: sessionid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_sentientia_live_sessions.id

FIELD.NAME: position
FIELD.COMMENT: Sort order within session (1-based)

FIELD.NAME: type
FIELD.COMMENT: Question type — multichoice / wordcloud / openended / rating / quiz / ranking

FIELD.NAME: title
FIELD.COMMENT: Audience-facing question text

FIELD.NAME: settings_json
FIELD.COMMENT: Type-specific config (see TABLE comment for schema)

INDEX.NAME: idx_session_position
INDEX.COMMENT: Render slides in order for one session

INDEX.NAME: idx_type
INDEX.COMMENT: Analytics: most-used question types per customer

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_live_participants
TABLE.COMMENT:
Audience members in a live session. One row per (session, audience-member) pair. For anonymous joins, userid is null and display_name carries the join handle.
Presence tracking via timelastseen — refreshed on every SSE heartbeat (~10s interval). Stale participants (timelastseen > 60s ago) considered offline for the trainer-side audience-count UI.

FIELD.NAME: sessionid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_sentientia_live_sessions.id

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to user.id — NULL for anonymous participants

FIELD.NAME: display_name
FIELD.COMMENT: Name shown in audience list / leaderboard. For logged-in users this defaults to fullname(); for anonymous joins it's the entered handle.

FIELD.NAME: join_token
FIELD.COMMENT: Random 40-char token. Anonymous participants use this as their bearer credential when POSTing responses (since they have no Moodle session). Also used to idempotent-rejoin a session on reconnect.

FIELD.NAME: timelastseen
FIELD.COMMENT: Last SSE heartbeat OR last response POST

KEY.NAME: uk_join_token
KEY.COMMENT: Token is the bearer credential — globally unique.

INDEX.NAME: idx_session_userid
INDEX.COMMENT: Idempotent rejoin: find existing row for (session, user)

INDEX.NAME: idx_session_lastseen
INDEX.COMMENT: Live audience-count: count where timelastseen > now - 60s

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_live_responses
TABLE.COMMENT:
Individual audience responses to one slide. Stored per-response (not per-slide-aggregate) so we can show a running tally + filter by participant.
Type-specific storage: multichoice: value_int = chosen option index rating: value_int = chosen rating quiz: value_int = chosen option index; value_correct (derived) = (value_int == correct_index) ranking: value_text = JSON array of item indices in order wordcloud: value_text = the entered word (single) openended: value_text = the free text

FIELD.NAME: slideid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_sentientia_live_slides.id

FIELD.NAME: participantid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_sentientia_live_participants.id — never null, even for anonymous (anon has a participant row keyed by join_token)

FIELD.NAME: value_int
FIELD.COMMENT: Numeric value (option index, rating, ...)

FIELD.NAME: value_text
FIELD.COMMENT: Text value (free response, ranking JSON, ...)

KEY.NAME: uk_slide_participant
KEY.COMMENT: One response per participant per slide. Re-submission updates the existing row.

INDEX.NAME: idx_slide_created
INDEX.COMMENT: Stream responses in arrival order for openended/wordcloud

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_live_events

FIELD.NAME: sessionid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_sentientia_live_sessions.id

FIELD.NAME: type
FIELD.COMMENT: Event type name (see TABLE comment for list)

FIELD.NAME: payload_json
FIELD.COMMENT: Type-specific JSON payload

INDEX.NAME: idx_session_id_window
INDEX.COMMENT: SSE poll query: WHERE sessionid = ? AND id > ? ORDER BY id ASC. This index is the hot path.

TABLE.NAME: local_sentientia_live_sse
TABLE.COMMENT:
Open Server-Sent-Events connection registry. See UAT-SECURITY-POSTURE-2026-09-03.md finding H4: stream.php held an Apache worker open for up to 300s per connection with no concurrency cap, a trivial volumetric DoS once anonymous audience join is enabled. One row per currently open stream.php connection; used to enforce a global concurrency cap (setting sse_max_connections) and a fixed per-actor cap of 2 concurrent streams.
sid is NOT the PHP/Moodle session id — stream.php calls session_write_close() before this table is ever touched, precisely so a stream never holds the session lock. sid is the per-actor identity used for the concurrency cap: u:USERID for a trainer stream, p:PARTICIPANTID for an audience stream (already scoped per anonymous join_token via the participants table), or ip:ADDRESS as a documented last-resort fallback. See classes/sse_connection_registry.php for the full design.
Rows are deleted on clean disconnect (release()); a prune() sweep removes rows whose timeheartbeat is older than 2x the ~15s ping interval as a backstop for Apache workers killed without running their PHP shutdown path.

FIELD.NAME: sessionid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to local_sentientia_live_sessions.id

FIELD.NAME: userid
FIELD.COMMENT: FK to user.id — NULL for an anonymous audience connection

FIELD.NAME: sid
FIELD.COMMENT: Per-actor identity key for the concurrency cap — see TABLE comment

FIELD.NAME: timeheartbeat
FIELD.COMMENT: Refreshed every ping interval (~15s) while the stream is open; prune() reaps rows older than 2x this interval
